title: OpenSees models for dynamic soil-structure interaction of wind turbine monopiles
description: OpenSees (Tcl) input files for the five numerical models (2D equalDOF, 2D Contact, BNWF, 3D equalDOF, 3D Contact) used to benchmark shaking table tests of a scaled wind turbine monopile system, accompanying the paper submitted to Earthquake Engineering & Structural Dynamics.
